cited_work: Will the Real Ubik Please Stand Up? (EdgeScience #20, Dec 2014)
relevant_topic: Precognition in PKD's fiction; the Ubik / ubiquinone correspondence
citation_context: Sarill — a physicist-turned-biochemist and a personal friend of Dick — argues that Ubik's described substance anticipates ubiquinone (CoQ10), knowledge unavailable to Dick in 1966.
claim_summary: Sarill contends the many name-and-property correspondences between the fictional Ubik and the real ubiquinone, combined with evidence that Dick could not have known of ubiquinone, point to precognition — while explicitly conceding this is 'synchronistic evidence consistent with precognition, not proof of it.'
